_doc: Human-readable description of the catalog entry schema. Each sibling file in this directory describes one integration tool available to Sage. Fields: id (machine-readable kebab-case, matches the filename without .json), name (display name shown to the owner), functions (one or more of the 14 function types listed below), tiers (list of connection paths ordered best-first: lowest tier number is most reliable and preferred), gotchas (short strings describing known failure modes or caveats), notes (one sentence summarising the tool's role in the Sage setup). Function types: lead_intake, crm, calendar, mail, text_phone, payments_invoicing, contracts_esign, scheduling_booking, file_storage, team_chat, accounting, social, automation, banking. Tier meanings: 1=official MCP connector or OAuth/API (most reliable), 2=official CLI tool, 3=export/import/mail-forwarding/webhooks/device automation, 4=Playwright browser automation on the vendor's site (last resort: fragile, may breach vendor terms). Status values within a tier: built=the code exists and runs in this repository, known=a real public API or CLI is confirmed to exist, unverified=existence or coverage is uncertain and should be verified. Safety invariant encoded in every entry: Sage never sends, pays, deletes, or publishes without an approval card from the owner; reads are always free.

fields.id: machine-readable kebab-case string, matches the filename without .json
fields.name: human display name for the owner
fields.functions: array of one or more of the 14 function type strings
fields.tiers: array of tier objects ordered best-first (see tier_schema below)
fields.gotchas: array of short strings describing known failure modes or caveats
fields.notes: one sentence summarising the tool's role in the Sage setup

tier_schema.tier: integer 1 through 4; see Tier meanings above
tier_schema.path: one of: mcp, api, cli, export, forwarding, webhook, browser, device
tier_schema.how: 2-4 sentences describing how Sage connects, what the owner must do to set it up, and where credentials or tokens are stored
tier_schema.reads: array of strings describing what Sage can read from this tool
tier_schema.writes: array of strings describing what Sage can write to this tool
tier_schema.always_tap: array of action descriptions that always require an owner approval card before Sage proceeds
tier_schema.status: one of: built (code exists in repo and runs), known (confirmed public API or CLI), unverified (uncertain; verify before building)
